help.title: Help & Support
help.intro: Short guides for everyday tasks, answers to common questions, and a direct line to our support team.

gettingStarted.title: Getting started
steps: Open Settings → Profile and fill in your service centre name, address, phone and logo. These appear on every invoice and quotation.
Add your team under Team → Member Management. Each member gets their own login and sees only what their role allows.
Add your service list and prices in Settings → Services so job cards fill in automatically.
Create your first job card from Workshop → Services → New Service.

services.title: Create and complete a job card
steps: Go to Workshop → Services and tap New Service.
Pick the customer and vehicle, or add a new one right there.
Add the services and parts used, and assign the technicians who worked on it.
Move the job through its stages, then convert it into an invoice when the work is done.

customers.title: Manage customers and vehicles
steps: Workshop → Customers holds every customer; open one to see their vehicles, past jobs and invoices.
Add a vehicle under the customer so its full service history stays in one place.
Use the share button to send a customer their own view of their service history — no login needed.
Service reminders go out by SMS based on what you set in Settings → Reminders.

invoices.title: Bill a customer
steps: Sales & Billing → Invoices → New Invoice, or convert a finished job card into an invoice.
Add the items, apply a discount if needed, and save.
Record payments as they come in — cash, card, cheque or credit.
Download the PDF or share the invoice on WhatsApp straight from the invoice page.

quotations.title: Send a quotation
steps: Sales & Billing → Quotations → New Quotation.
Add the estimated services and parts, then save and share it with the customer.
When the customer approves, convert the quotation into a job card or an invoice — no re-typing.

pos.title: Sell over the counter (POS)
steps: Stock & Supply → Outlets & POS is where outlets are managed, a cashier is assigned, and sales are reviewed.
The register itself is a separate shareable link, opened on its own device at the counter — no staff login needed there.
Every sale reduces stock automatically; review the day's sales under Outlets & POS → Sales History.

inventory.title: Keep stock accurate
steps: Stock & Supply → Inventory lists every part with its cost, selling price and quantity in hand.
Staff ask for parts through Inventory Requests; a manager approves and the stock moves out.
Record purchases under Suppliers so cost prices and payables stay up to date.
Run a stock count from the Inventory page to correct differences between the system and the shelf.

money.title: Track money in and out
steps: Sales & Billing → Accounting shows income, expenses and profit for any date range.
Record expenses as they happen so the profit figure stays real.
Cheques & Credits tracks cheques received and customer credit, and warns you before a cheque date.

team.title: Manage your team
steps: Team → Member Management to add a member, set their role and share their login.
Team → Attendance for daily check-in and check-out records.
Settings → Role Permissions to control exactly what each role can see and do.

reports.title: See how the business is doing
steps: Reports → Analytics & Reports covers revenue, services, customers, suppliers and SMS.
Choose a date range at the top; every report follows it.
Export any report to CSV so your accountant can open it in Excel.

settings.title: Settings you set once
steps: Profile — business details, logo and the footer printed on invoices.
SMS and Reminders — sender name, message templates and when reminders go out.
Services — your standard service list and prices.
Subscription — your plan, payments and upgrade requests.

offline.title: Working with a weak connection
steps: The app keeps working offline; new records are saved on the device.
The badge at the top of the sidebar shows the connection status and how many changes are waiting.
Everything syncs on its own once the connection returns — do not clear the browser data while changes are still waiting.

staffPassword.q: A staff member forgot their password. What do I do?
staffPassword.a: Open Team → Member Management, open that member and reset the password. The new password is shown once, so share it with them straight away.

proPlan.q: Why is a menu item marked PRO?
proPlan.a: Those features belong to the Pro plan. Tap the item to see what it unlocks, or go to Settings → Subscription to upgrade.

addBranch.q: How do I add another branch?
addBranch.a: Branches are added by us. Contact support below and we will set it up on your account; after that you can switch branches from the top of the sidebar.

smsNotSending.q: Customers are not receiving SMS. Why?
smsNotSending.a: Check Settings → SMS: the sender name must be approved and your SMS balance must not be empty. SMS Logs, under Reports, shows the delivery status of every message.

fixInvoice.q: I made a mistake on an invoice. Can I fix it?
fixInvoice.a: Yes. Open the invoice and edit it while it is still unpaid. Once payments are recorded, add a correcting entry instead — or contact support — so the history stays accurate.

dataSafe.a: Your data is stored securely in the cloud and backed up automatically. Only the members you invite can see it, and each role sees only what you allow.
